arguments.command:
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}"; D=.claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py;
OUT=/workspace/.tmp/drag_during.json;
$D call ext.nothingness.dragByKey key=hero-seek-gesture dx=300 dy=0 steps=20 shotStep=10 pixelRatio=1.0 kind=touch > "$OUT";
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,base64,os
out='/workspace/.tmp/seek_during.png'
with open('/workspace/.tmp/drag_during.json','r') as f:
    res=json.load(f)
mid=res.get('duringPng_base64')
assert mid, f"missing duringPng_base64 keys={list(res.keys())}"
open(out,'wb').write(base64.b64decode(mid))
print('wrote',out)
print('during dims',res.get('duringWidth'),res.get('duringHeight'))
PY
